question: Related Questions Q. Please explain as per sharia law what is Tarka between 5 brothers 3 sisters. 6340 views Q. Assalam-U-Alaikum. We are 2 brothers & 1 sister in my family.We have one flat which is on my fathers name, where I stay with my parents.My brother was in need to money to buy his own flat, for that we decided to help him. For that we fixed our fathers flat price as 30 lakhs, and considered as 10 lakhs each for 2 brothers & 1 sister. So i kept the fathers flat, and paid 10 lakhs each to sister and brother. Now brother has its own flat on his name. But this flat which i purchased from my father is still on my fathers name. My father says let it be on his name only, and he just signed on one blank paper that this flat belongs to my younger son (me). Whenever my father is not in this world, can my brother & sister can claim their share in my fathers flat, which i have owned but still on fathers name. Is there a solution for this, where in Islam, I can avoid my brother & sister claiming for fathers flat later. May Allah make my father live longer happily & on Islam. Please advise me. 2147 views Q. My mom elder brother after the death of my mom father is managing the entire business and controlling the property from last 30 years, which is in the name of my mom fathers, the property has not been divided as per law. From this business he has acquired lots of cash and other assets. My question is the wealth which he has acquired from last 30 years without the permission of the inheritors should be include into the entire share or it should be exclude from the share at the time of division of inheritance.please help me out. 1665 views Q. But I want to distribute my property less or more (adjustment) way (not equally). Those (son or daughter) who is financially week or not good condition or other reasons etc.. I want to support them. Can a Muslim gift his self earned property after disowning his surviving son to his grandsons and wife and three daughters? 4031 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 51011 Country: India Title: inheritence Question: A person dies leaving behind his wife, three sons and one daughter [1 wife, 3 sons, 1 daughter]. How shall his property be divided? Answer ID: 51011 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 430/390/N=04/1435) In the question mentioned above, if the details are correct then all the property of the deceased person shall be divided into 8 shares, after paying due rights preceding inheritance. Out of the total, the wife of the deceased person shall get 1 share, 2-2 shares shall go to each son while the daughter shall get 1 share. The detail of division is as follows: Details: Wife: 1x1=1 Sons: 2x2=4 Daughter: 1x1=1 Total: 8 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
